questions.question: The ratio of the ages of Swetha and Santoshi is 9 ∶ 4. If after 10 years, Santoshi's age would be the same as the present age of Swetha. Find the present ages of Swetha & Santoshi (in years)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of ages of Swetha and Santoshi = 9: 4

After 10 years, Santoshi age = Present age of Swetha

**Concept Used:**

**Calculations:**

Ratio of ages of Swetha and Santoshi = 9: 4

Let the Present age of Swetha = 9x

The present age of Santoshi = 4x

After 10 years,

Santoshi age will be = 4x + 10

According to the question,

The present age of Swetha = Age of Santoshi after 10 years

⇒ 9x = 4x + 10

⇒ 5x = 10

⇒ x = 2

Present age of Swetha = 9x = 9 x 2 = 18 years

Present age of Santoshi = 4x = 4 x 2 = 8 years

**Hence, Option (4) is correct**

questions.question: If the mode of a data exceeds its mean by 33.6, then the mode exceeds the median by _____. (Use empirical formula to find the answer.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Empirical relation: Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

⇒ Mode − Mean = 3(Median − Mean)

Given Mode − Mean = 33.6

⇒ Median − Mean = 33.6 ÷ 3 = 11.2

⇒ Mode − Median = 33.6 − 11.2 = 22.4

**∴ Answer = 22.4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mode − Mean = 33.6

**Formula used:**

Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mode − Mean = (3Median − 2Mean) − Mean

⇒ Mode − Mean = 3Median − 3Mean

⇒ Mode − Mean = 3(Median − Mean)

⇒ 33.6 = 3(Median − Mean)

⇒ Median − Mean = 11.2

⇒ Mode − Median = (Mode − Mean) − (Median − Mean)

⇒ = 33.6 − 11.2 = 22.4

**∴ The correct answer is 22.4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Formula

Mode = 3Median − 2Mean. Used for moderately skewed distributions.

Relation Derived

Mode − Mean = 3(Median − Mean)

Difference Relation

Mode − Median = (Mode − Mean) − (Median − Mean)

Use Case

Applicable when exact data is not given but mean, median, and mode are related.

questions.question: In case of a particular transaction, the profit earned is 14(2)/({7)}%. What fraction is the cost price of the selling price?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **Profit %** to fraction: 14 2/7% = 1/7.

Here, **Denominator (7)** represents the **Cost Price (CP)** and **Numerator (1)** represents the **Profit**.

**Selling Price (SP)** = CP + Profit = 7 + 1 = 8 units.

Required fraction (**CP/SP**) = 7/8.

**∴ The correct answer is 7/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Profit percentage** = 14 2/7% = (100/7)%.

**Formula Used:** **Selling Price (SP)** = Cost Price (CP) + Profit; **Profit %** = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28b501e38afd97887adce4e336cad9cdf108c3ac421156f4089ae720b2a59df3.png] 

⇒ **Profit fraction** = (100/7) ÷ 100 = 1/7

⇒ This implies that for every 7 units of **Cost Price**, the **Profit** earned is 1 unit.

⇒ Let **Cost Price (CP)** = 7x

⇒ **Profit** = 1x

⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = CP + Profit = 7x + 1x = 8x

⇒ **Fraction of CP to SP** = CP ÷ SP = 7x ÷ 8x

⇒ **Fraction** = 7/8

**∴ The correct answer is 7/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Common percentages like 14 2/7% = 1/7, 12 1/2% = 1/8, and 11 1/9% = 1/9 are essential for solving **Profit and Loss** questions quickly.

CP and SP Relationship

If **Profit %** is expressed as a fraction a/b, then the ratio of **CP : SP** is always b : (b + a). For a **Loss %** of a/b, the ratio of **CP : SP** is b : (b − a).

Marked Price and Discount

**Selling Price** can also be calculated using **Marked Price (MP)**: SP = MP × (1 − Discount%/100).</p

questions.question: An equilateral triangle with side a units is cut on the vertices to make it a regular hexagon. What is the area of the hexagon?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the vertices of an equilateral triangle are cut to form a regular hexagon, the side length is exactly trisected.

Side of the regular hexagon = Side of triangle ÷ 3 = a / 3.

Area of a regular hexagon = 6 × Area of small equilateral triangle = 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × (side)².

Area = 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × (a / 3)² = (3√3 ÷ 2) × (a² ÷ 9).

Area = √3a² ÷ 6 = a² / (2√3).

**∴ The correct answer is a² / (2√3) square units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

An equilateral triangle with side length a.

The vertices are cut out to make a regular hexagon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb8eb3c3a2a9280f95e8000567cd3f085a672eef9ef775704cce98cd3367960e.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

Area of a regular hexagon = 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × x² (where x is the side length)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the side length of the regular hexagon be x.

⇒ When cutting the vertices of an equilateral triangle to form a regular hexagon, the cut-out portions are smaller equilateral triangles of side length x.

⇒ The original side 'a' consists of three linear segments: one side of a cut-off triangle, one side of the hexagon, and one side of another cut-off triangle.

⇒ x + x + x = a

⇒ 3x = a

⇒ x = a / 3

⇒ The area of the regular hexagon is the combined area of 6 small equilateral triangles of side x.

⇒ Area = 6 × [(√3 ÷ 4) × (a / 3)²]

⇒ Area = 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × (a² ÷ 9)

⇒ Area = (6√3 × a²) ÷ 36

⇒ Area = (√3 × a²) ÷ 6

⇒ Multiplying numerator and denominator by √3 to simplify the fraction:

⇒ Area = (√3 × √3 × a²) ÷ (6 × √3) = 3a² ÷ 6√3

⇒ Area = a² / (2√3)

**∴ The correct answer is a² / (2√3) square units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of an Equilateral Triangle

The area of an equilateral triangle with side 'a' is given by Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a², and its height is h = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.

Regular Hexagon Area

A regular hexagon with side 'x' is structurally made of 6 identical equilateral triangles. Its total area is 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × x² = (3√3 ÷ 2) × x².

Inradius & Circumradius of Equilateral Triangle

For an equilateral triangle of side 'a', the inradius is r = a ÷ (2√3) and the circumradius is R = a ÷ √3. Note that the circumradius is always exactly double the inradius (R = 2r).

Max Area Hexagon in a Triangle

The largest regular hexagon that can be inscribed in any equilateral triangle is formed precisely by cutting off its corners, and its side length is always strictly one-third of the parent triangle's side.

questions.question: The Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM) is:

options.text: A constitutional body under Article 243W mandated to regulate urban air quality in metropolitan regions.
A statutory regulator under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, exercising nationwide jurisdiction over air pollution control.
A temporary committee constituted by the Supreme Court to monitor compliance with directions on stubble burning and vehicular emissions.
A statutory body established by a specific Act of Parliament with jurisdiction over the NCR and adjoining areas to coordinate air quality management across States.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Supreme Court sought the Union government’s response on proposals to shift coal-based industries out of Delhi-NCR and took note of long-term recommendations made by the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) regarding thermal power plants and vehicular emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• CAQM is a statutory body created by a dedicated Act of Parliament to coordinate, plan, implement and monitor measures for air quality management in the NCR and adjoining areas, cutting across State jurisdictions. **Hence, Option D is correct. **
 
• CAQM is not a constitutional body under Article 243W; urban local bodies have functions relating to public health and sanitation, but CAQM’s mandate flows from statute. **Hence, Option A is incorrect. **
 
• CAQM does not derive its powers from the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, nor does it exercise nationwide jurisdiction; its territorial remit is NCR and adjoining areas.** Hence, Option B is incorrect. **
 
• CAQM is not a court-appointed temporary committee; it is a permanent statutory authority. **Hence, Option C is incorrect. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• CAQM replaced the earlier EPCA mechanism for NCR with enforceable statutory powers.
 
• NCR includes Delhi and parts of Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan.
 
• CAQM can issue binding directions to State governments and agencies for air quality measures.
 
• Long-term measures discussed include curbs on coal-based thermal plants near NCR, vehicular emission control and stubble-burning mitigation.

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a work in 12, 15 and 20 days, respectively. How many days are required to finish the work if they work together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 12 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 15 days

Time taken by C to complete the work = 20 days

**Formula used:**

Time required to complete the work when A, B, and C work together = 1 / (Total work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day)

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1 / 12

Work done by B in 1 day = 1 / 15

Work done by C in 1 day = 1 / 20

Total work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day = 1 / 12 + 1 / 15 + 1 / 20

Finding a common denominator:

LCM of 12, 15, and 20 = 60

Work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day = (5 + 4 + 3) / 60 = 12 / 60 = 1 / 5

Time required to complete the work = 1 / (1 / 5) = 5 days

**∴ The work will be completed in 5 days if A, B, and C work together.**

questions.question: Rajiv's salary was first decreased by 40% and subsequently increased by 50%. How much percent did he lose from his initial salary?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net percentage change formula = a + b + (a × b)/100

Here, a = −40% (decrease) and b = +50% (increase).

Net change = −40 + 50 + [(−40 × 50)/100] = 10 − 20 = −10%.

Negative sign indicates a loss.

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ Let the initial salary of **Rajiv** be 100.

⇒ After **40% decrease**, salary = 100 − 40 = 60.

⇒ After **50% increase** on 60, increase = 60 × (50/100) = 30.

⇒ Final salary = 60 + 30 = 90.

⇒ Percentage loss = [(Initial − Final)/Initial] × 100

⇒ Percentage loss = [(100 − 90)/100] × 100 = 10%.

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: Kamal is the father of Vishnu. The sum of their present ages is 60 years. If 6 years ago, Kamal’s age was 5 times the then age of Vishnu, then find the present age (in years) of Vishnu.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of ages **6 years ago** = 60 − (2 × 6) = 48 years.

Ratio of **Kamal : Vishnu** was 5 : 1.

Total ratio parts = 5 + 1 = 6 units → 48 years.

1 unit = 8 years ∴ **Vishnu's age** 6 years ago was 8 years.

Present age of Vishnu = 8 + 6 = 14 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of **Kamal (K)** and **Vishnu (V)** = 60 years. 6 years ago, K − 6 = 5 × (V − 6).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36c7c2e521536012c8faafaa37203e852bc4f0125ef75ad39e17e91ddb19d033.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Vishnu's age 6 years ago be **x**. Then Kamal's age was **5x**.

⇒ Present age of Vishnu = x + 6 and Kamal = 5x + 6.

⇒ Sum = (5x + 6) + (x + 6) = 60

⇒ 6x + 12 = 60

⇒ 6x = 48 ⇒ x = 8

⇒ Present age of Vishnu = 8 + 6 = 14 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 years.**

Age Difference Property

The **difference between the ages** of two people always remains constant, regardless of the number of years passed or preceding.

Sum of Ages Shift

If the sum of ages of 'n' people is S today, then 't' years ago, the sum was **S − (n × t)**.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio of 3 : 7. If 11 is subtracted from each, the ratio between the numbers becomes 7 : 20. Find the smaller number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two numbers are in the ratio of 3 : 7.

**Formula used:**

Let the two numbers be 3x and 7x.

If 11 is subtracted from each number, the new ratio is 7 : 20.

**Calculation:**

New numbers: 3x - 11 and 7x - 11

New ratio: (3x - 11) / (7x - 11) = 7 / 20

⇒ 20(3x - 11) = 7(7x - 11)

⇒ 60x - 220 = 49x - 77

⇒ 60x - 49x = 220 - 77

⇒ 11x = 143

⇒ x = 13

Smaller number = 3x = 3 × 13 = 39

**∴ The smaller number is 39.**

questions.question: If (p - q) = - 6, (q - r) = 5 and (r - p) = 1, then find the value of (p³ + q³ + r³ - 3pqr)/(p + q + r).
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **algebraic identity** for the given expression is:

(p³ + q³ + r³ − 3pqr) / (p + q + r) = ½ × [(p − q)² + (q − r)² + (r − p)²]

Substitute the given differences: ½ × [(−6)² + 5² + 1²]

⇒ ½ × [36 + 25 + 1] = 62 / 2 = 31

**∴ The correct answer is 31.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(p − q) = −6

(q − r) = 5

(r − p) = 1

**Formula Used:**

p³ + q³ + r³ − 3pqr = (p + q + r) × ½ × [(p − q)² + (q − r)² + (r − p)²]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8381ea150e16e7a14dbd94113d6cc43829e1c05c58c4bed4f34432c3e0d316c2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Target = (p³ + q³ + r³ − 3pqr) / (p + q + r)

⇒ Target = [(p + q + r) × ½ × {(p − q)² + (q − r)² + (r − p)²}] / (p + q + r)

⇒ Target = ½ × [(−6)² + 5² + 1²]

⇒ Target = ½ × [36 + 25 + 1]

⇒ Target = 62 / 2

⇒ Target = 31

**∴ The correct answer is 31.**

**__Additional Information__**

The Cube Identity

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca). This is a fundamental expansion used in algebraic simplifications.

Sum of Squares Alternative

The expression (a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca) can always be written as ½[(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²], which is useful when differences are known.

Special Case: a + b + c = 0

If the sum of the variables is zero, then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc. This is frequently tested in competitive exams.

Special Case: a = b = c

If all three variables are equal, then the value of the expression a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc is always zero.</p

questions.question: If the ratio of the principal and the simple interest for 5 years is 10 ∶ 7, then the rate of interest per annum is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **ratio** of **Principal** to **Simple Interest** is 10 : 7 for 5 years.

Total interest earned over 5 years as a percentage = (7 ÷ 10) × 100 = 70%.

**Rate of interest per annum** = Total percentage ÷ Time = 70% ÷ 5 = 14%.

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Principal** (P) and **Simple Interest** (SI) = 10 : 7

**Time** (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad76a95b68ee8cd483ec604ea2accb4dc6a3853dcb4604a4fa55cd7e1893a76e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Principal** (P) be 10x and **Simple Interest** (SI) be 7x.

⇒ 7x = (10x × R × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ 7 = (50 × R) ÷ 100

⇒ 7 = R ÷ 2

⇒ R = 7 × 2

⇒ R = 14%

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

Simple interest is calculated only on the initial principal amount: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Total Amount

The total amount (A) after the time period is the sum of the principal and the interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT/100).

Rate and Time Relation

The rate (R) and time (T) are inversely proportional for a constant interest amount: R = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T).</p

⇒ 512 + __**10 × 30**__ - 64 = 20

⇒ __**512 + 300**__ - 64 = 20

⇒ __**812 - 64**__ = 20

⇒ __**32768 + 0.25**__ - 50 = 30

⇒ __**32768.25 - 50**__ = 30

⇒ 32718.25 ≠ 30

LHS ≠ RHS

⇒ __**8 × 5**__ + 30 - 20 = 50

⇒ __**40 + 30**__ - 20 = 50

**LHS = RHS**

questions.question: If (x²+(1)/(x²))=(17)/(4), then what is (x³-(1)/(x³)) equal to?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

If x² + 1/x² = k, then (x − 1/x) = √(k − 2).

Given k = 17/4, so (x − 1/x) = √(17/4 − 2) = √(9/4) = 3/2.

Using the shortcut x³ − 1/x³ = n³ + 3n, where n = (x − 1/x).

Result = (3/2)³ + 3(3/2) = 27/8 + 9/2 = 63/8.

**∴ The correct answer is 63/8.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x² + 1/x² = 17/4

**Formula Used:** (x − 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² − 2 and x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x − 1/x)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4ff6ba9b18c69abb5861b8536e1741017376bcab995d46aedf4e44d46a4022a.png] 

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = (x² + 1/x²) − 2

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 17/4 − 2

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = (17 − 8) / 4 = 9/4

⇒ x − 1/x = √(9/4) = 3/2

Now, finding the **cubic expansion**:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x)(1/x)(x − 1/x)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (3/2)³ + 3(3/2)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 27/8 + 9/2

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (27 + 36) / 8 = 63/8

**∴ The correct answer is 63/8.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for Squares

(x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2 and (x − 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² − 2.

Algebraic Identity for Cubes

x³ + 1/x³ = (x + 1/x)³ − 3(x + 1/x) and x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x − 1/x).

Relation between Sum and Difference

(x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4.</p

questions.question: The ratio of radii of a cylinder to a that of a cone is 1 : 2. if their heights are equal, find the ratio of their volumes
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Volume of Cylinder** (V꜀y) to **Volume of Cone** (V꜀ₒ) is given by πr₁²h : (1/3)πr₂²h.

Since **heights** are equal, ratio is r₁² : (1/3)r₂².

Given **radius ratio** r₁ : r₂ = 1 : 2.

Ratio = 1² : (1/3)×2² = 1 : 4/3 = 3 : 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Radii** (r₁ : r₂) = 1 : 2

Ratio of **Heights** (h₁ : h₂) = 1 : 1

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **Cylinder** = πr²h

Volume of **Cone** = (1/3)πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/832acbcf9f7658e4407f7ba2ee6289430061f13fdb3648010098125829a1d66b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let radius of **Cylinder** = x and radius of **Cone** = 2x.

⇒ Let the height of both be h.

⇒ Volume of **Cylinder** (V₁) = π × (x)² × h = πx²h

⇒ Volume of **Cone** (V₂) = (1/3) × π × (2x)² × h = (4/3)πx²h

⇒ Ratio = V₁ : V₂ = πx²h : (4/3)πx²h

⇒ Ratio = 1 : 4/3

⇒ Ratio = 3 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 4.**

The total surface area of a **Cylinder** is given by 2πr(h + r), including both the curved surface and the two circular bases.

n = number of years

Prime Numbers

A **prime number** is a natural number greater than 1 that has only two factors: 1 and itself.

questions.question: The average of the three numbers is 30. If the value of C is six times of the value of A and the value of A is half the value of B. Find the value of A + B - C.

Ratio of **A : B : C** = 1 : 2 : 6 (since A = B/2 and C = 6A).

Total ratio units = 1 + 2 + 6 = 9 units.

Total sum of numbers = **Average × Count** = 30 × 3 = 90.

Value of 1 unit (A) = 90 ÷ 9 = 10.

Required value (A + B − C) in units = 1 + 2 − 6 = −3 units.

Final Value = −3 × 10 = −30.

**∴ The correct answer is -30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

C = 6 × A

⇒ Let A = x, then B = 2x and C = 6x

⇒ x + 2x + 6x = 90

⇒ 9x = 90

⇒ x = 10

⇒ A = 10, B = 20, C = 60

⇒ A + B − C = 10 + 20 − 60

⇒ A + B − C = 30 − 60 = −30

**∴ The correct answer is -30.**

questions.question: The roots of the quadratic equation x + frac{{20}}{x} = 9 are:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the equation to standard form: x² − 9x + 20 = 0.

Look for two numbers whose **Sum is 9** and **Product is 20**.

Factors of 20 are (1, 20), (2, 10), and (4, 5).

Only the pair (4, 5) satisfies the condition: 4 + 5 = 9 and 4 × 5 = 20.

**∴ The correct answer is 4, 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Equation:** x + 20/x = 9

**Method:** Factorisation of Quadratic Equation

⇒ (x² + 20) / x = 9

⇒ x² + 20 = 9x

⇒ x² − 9x + 20 = 0

⇒ x² − 5x − 4x + 20 = 0

⇒ x(x − 5) − 4(x − 5) = 0

⇒ (x − 5)(x − 4) = 0

⇒ x − 5 = 0 or x − 4 = 0

⇒ x = 5 or x = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4, 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Nature of Roots

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the **Discriminant (D)** is b² − 4ac. If D > 0, roots are real and distinct; if D = 0, roots are real and equal; if D < 0, roots are imaginary.

Sum and Product of Roots

If α and β are the roots, then **Sum of roots** (α + β) = −b/a and **Product of roots** (αβ) = c/a.

Quadratic Formula

The roots can also be found using x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)] / 2a.</p

questions.question: The average weight of 6 persons is increased by 1.5 kg when a new person replaces the one whose weight is 45 kg. How much should a new person weigh?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**New weight** = **Old weight** + (**Number of persons** × **Average increase**)

New weight = 45 + (6 × 1.5)

New weight = 45 + 9 = 54 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 54 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ Total weight increase of the **6 persons** = 6 × 1.5 kg = 9 kg.

⇒ When a **new person** replaces the one weighing 45 kg, the total weight of the group increases by 9 kg.

⇒ **Weight of new person** = weight of the person who left + total increase in weight.

⇒ **Weight of new person** = 45 + 9 = 54 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 54 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Weight Concept

Replacement (Decrease) Formula

questions.question: A thief committed a crime and escaped from the spot at a speed of 12 m/h. A Security guard started chasing him 20 minutes after the thief started running and caught him in the next 20 minutes. What is the speed (in m/h) of the Security guard?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Thief**'s total travel time = 20 + 20 = 40 minutes.

**Security guard**'s total travel time = 20 minutes.

Since the distance is constant, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time**.

Time ratio (Thief : Guard) = 40 : 20 = 2 : 1.

Speed ratio (Thief : Guard) = 1 : 2.

Given Thief's speed = 12 m/h → 1 unit = 12 m/h ∴ 2 units = 24 m/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m/h.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of **Thief** (Sₜ) = 12 m/h

Time headstart = 20 minutes

Time taken to catch (T꜀) = 20 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Relative Speed (same direction) = Sgᵤₐᵣd − Sₜₕᵢₑf

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3921b56b107ef66712f4e0e4b626c23e0b913353c8d033a1a0423d1cb136b44.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total time the **Thief** ran = 20 + 20 = 40 minutes = 40/60 hours = 2/3 hours.

⇒ Total distance covered by **Thief** = 12 × (2/3) = 8 meters.

⇒ The **Security guard** covers this same 8 meters in 20 minutes.

⇒ Time for guard = 20/60 hours = 1/3 hours.

⇒ Speed of **Security guard** = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Speed = 8 ÷ (1/3) = 8 × 3 = 24 m/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m/h.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, the relative speed is the difference of their speeds (u − v). For chasing, the catcher's speed must be greater.

Catching Time Formula

Time to catch = (Initial Distance between them) ÷ (Relative Speed).

Distance Constant Relation

If distance is constant, Speed₁ × Time₁ = Speed₂ × Time₂.</p

• Understanding their interactions helps identify new therapeutic targets.
